answer: The Plus plan costs 6 USD per month and includes unlimited notebooks and 10 GB of storage [billing-plans].
The Team plan costs 10 USD per user per month and adds shared notebooks and admin controls [billing-plans].
The Free plan includes up to 3 notebooks and 100 MB of storage [billing-plans].
Yes. Annual billing gives a 20 percent discount on Plus and Team [billing-plans].
Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of the first payment. Request it from Settings, then Billing, then Request refund [refunds].
Renewals are not refunded, but you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the period [refunds].
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days [refunds].

Yes. Full account exports are available on every plan, including Free, and produce a ZIP file with every notebook in Markdown plus attachments [export-data].
On the Team plan you can share notebooks with teammates as viewer, commenter or editor [sharing].
